name: canvas-layout
title: CanvasLayout
description: Editor shell for a full-bleed canvas (flow editor, code editor, map): top bar · left palette · canvas with a floating toolbar · right inspector · collapsible bottom console. Palette and inspector toggle from the top bar; each panel is controllable (`paletteOpen`, `inspectorOpen`, `consoleOpen`). Below `lg` the side panels and toggles hide and a read-only notice ("Open on a larger screen to edit") shows over the canvas. Fills its container; `fullScreen` switches to `h-dvh`.
author: gntik-ai
